CodeBehindForm
Attribute VB_GlobalNameSpace = False
Attribute VB_Creatable = True
Attribute VB_PredeclaredId = True
Attribute VB_Exposed = False
Option Compare Database
Option Explicit


Private Sub Form_Load()
    Dim strSQL As String
    Dim GewM35212 As Single
    Dim GewM35221 As Single
    Dim GewM35231 As Single

    Dim KundenID As Long
    Dim KundenAnsprechpersonID As Long
    Dim Messart As String
    Dim Transporteur As String
    Dim Transportart As String
    Dim ArtikelAnz As Long
    Dim FehlerTxt As String
    Dim LSNr As Long
    Dim BSNr As Long
    'pr?fen ob genau ein LS/BS vorhanden ist
    If DCount("LSNr", "Lieferscheine", "ProjektNr = " & ProjektNr) = 1 Then
        LSNr = DLookup("LSNr", "Lieferscheine", "ProjektNr = " & ProjektNr)
    End If

    If DCount("BSNr", "Begleitscheine", "ProjektNr = " & ProjektNr) = 1 Then
        BSNr = DLookup("BSNr", "Begleitscheine", "ProjektNr = " & ProjektNr)
    End If
    
    'pr?fen ob mehr als ein LS/BS vorhanden ist
    If DCount("LSNr", "Lieferscheine", "ProjektNr = " & ProjektNr) > 1 Then
        FehlerMeldung "es sind mehrere Lieferscheine f?r dieses Projekt vorhanden!"
        Exit Sub
    End If
    
    If DCount("BSNr", "Begleitscheine", "ProjektNr = " & ProjektNr) > 1 Then
        FehlerMeldung "es sind mehrere Begleitscheine f?r dieses Projekt vorhanden!"
        Exit Sub
    End If
    
    '************** wenn keine LS/BS vorhanden sind werden welche erzeugt **********************
    If DCount("LSNr", "Lieferscheine", "ProjektNr = " & ProjektNr) = 0 And DCount("BSNr", "Begleitscheine", "ProjektNr = " & ProjektNr) = 0 Then
    
        ArtikelAnz = DCount("ALID", "ArtikelListe", "ProjektNr = " & ProjektNr)
        
        ' Pr?fen, ob Artikel vorhanden sind
        If ArtikelAnz = 0 Then
            FehlerMeldung "Es sind keine Artikel in der Abholliste zu diesem Projekt vorhanden. Bitte die Abholliste bearbeiten!!!"
            Exit Sub
        End If
        
        KundenID = DLookup("KundenID", "Projekte", "ProjektNr = " & ProjektNr)
        
        ' Fehlende Kundendaten sammeln
        If Nz(DLookup("GLN", "Kunden", "KundenID = " & KundenID), 0) = 0 Then
            FehlerTxt = FehlerTxt & vbCrLf & "- GLN"
        End If
        
        If Nz(DLookup("LSAdresse", "Kunden", "KundenID = " & KundenID), "") = "" Then
            FehlerTxt = FehlerTxt & vbCrLf & "- LS-Adresse"
        End If
        
        If Nz(DLookup("LSPLZ", "Kunden", "KundenID = " & KundenID), "") = "" Then
            FehlerTxt = FehlerTxt & vbCrLf & "- LS-Postleitzahl"
        End If
        
        If Nz(DLookup("LSOrt", "Kunden", "KundenID = " & KundenID), "") = "" Then
            FehlerTxt = FehlerTxt & vbCrLf & "- LS-Ort"
        End If
        
        ' Wenn etwas fehlt: genau eine Meldung ausgeben
        If FehlerTxt <> "" Then
            FehlerMeldung "Folgende Kundendaten fehlen fuer die Erstellung des Lieferscheins:" & vbCrLf & FehlerTxt & vbCrLf & vbCrLf & "Bitte die Kundendaten bearbeiten!!!"
            Exit Sub
        End If
        
        ' wenn nicht gef?hrliche Artikel vorhanden sind dann Lieferschein anlegen
        If DCount("ALID", "ArtikelListe", "ProjektNr = " & ProjektNr & " AND ArtikelKatID <> 9") > 0 Then
            LSNr = ErzeugeDokumentDatensatz("Lieferscheine", "LSNr", ProjektNr, 20000, 25000)
            If LSNr = 0 Then Exit Sub
        Else
            LSNr = 0
        End If
        
        ' Pr?fen, ob ein Begleitschein n?tig ist, also on TFT-Bildschirme vorhanden sind
        If DCount("ALID", "ArtikelListe", "ProjektNr = " & ProjektNr & " AND ArtikelKatID = 9") > 0 Then
            BSNr = ErzeugeDokumentDatensatz("Begleitscheine", "BSNr", ProjektNr, 2000, 4000)
            If BSNr = 0 Then Exit Sub
        Else
            BSNr = 0
        End If
        
        LSBSButtonAufBearbeitenSetzen
        
        GewM35212 = Nz(DSum("GesGewicht", "A_LSListeGewicht35212"), 0)
        GewM35221 = Nz(DSum("GesGewicht", "A_LSListeGewicht35221"), 0)
        GewM35231 = Nz(DSum("GesGewicht", "A_LSListeGewicht35231"), 0)
        
        If LSNr > 0 Then
            KundenAnsprechpersonID = DLookup("KundenAnsprechpersonID", "Projekte", "ProjektNr =" & ProjektNr)
            Messart = Nz(DLookup("Messart", "Messarten", "ID = 1"), "")
            Transportart = Nz(DLookup("Transportart", "Transportarten", "ID = 1"), "")
            Transporteur = Nz(DLookup("Transporteur", "Transporteure", "ID = 1"), "")
            strSQL = "UPDATE Lieferscheine SET " & _
                     "M35231 = " & GewM35231 & ", " & _
                     "A35231 = '" & Messart & "', " & _
                     "M35221 = " & GewM35221 & ", " & _
                     "A35221 = '" & Messart & "', " & _
                     "UebernahmeDatum = Date(), " & _
                     "Transportart = '" & Transportart & "', " & _
                     "Transporteur = '" & Transporteur & "', " & _
                     "EmpfangsDatum = Date() " & _
                     "WHERE LSNr = " & LSNr & ";"
            
            DoCmd.SetWarnings False
            DoCmd.RunSQL strSQL
            DoCmd.SetWarnings True
            If IsNull(DLookup("Strasse", "KundenAnsprechperson", "KundenAnsprechpersonID =" & KundenAnsprechpersonID)) Then
                strSQL = "UPDATE Lieferscheine SET " & _
                         "UeNAdresse = '" & LSAdresse & "', " & _
                         "UeNPLZ = '" & LSPLZ & "', " & _
                         "UeNOrt = '" & LSOrt & "' " & _
                         "WHERE LSNr = " & LSNr & ";"
                DoCmd.SetWarnings False
                DoCmd.RunSQL strSQL
                DoCmd.SetWarnings True
            End If
            Me.Requery
        End If
        
        If BSNr > 0 Then
            KundenAnsprechpersonID = DLookup("KundenAnsprechpersonID", "Projekte", "ProjektNr =" & ProjektNr)
            Messart = Nz(DLookup("Messart", "Messarten", "ID = 1"), "")
            Transportart = Nz(DLookup("Transportart", "Transportarten", "ID = 1"), "")
            Transporteur = Nz(DLookup("Transporteur", "Transporteure", "ID = 1"), "")
            
            strSQL = "UPDATE Begleitscheine SET " & _
                     "M35212 = " & GewM35212 & ", " & _
                     "A35212 = '" & Messart & "', " & _
                     "UebernahmeDatum = Date(), " & _
                     "Transportart = '" & Transportart & "', " & _
                     "Transporteur = '" & Transporteur & "', " & _
                     "EmpfangsDatum = Date() " & _
                     "WHERE BSNr = " & BSNr & ";"
            
            DoCmd.SetWarnings False
            DoCmd.RunSQL strSQL
            DoCmd.SetWarnings True
            
            If IsNull(DLookup("Strasse", "KundenAnsprechperson", "KundenAnsprechpersonID =" & KundenAnsprechpersonID)) Then
                strSQL = "UPDATE Begleitscheine SET " & _
                         "UeNAdresse = '" & LSAdresse & "', " & _
                         "UeNPLZ = '" & LSPLZ & "', " & _
                         "UeNOrt = '" & LSOrt & "' " & _
                         "WHERE BSNr = " & BSNr & ";"
                DoCmd.SetWarnings False
                DoCmd.RunSQL strSQL
                DoCmd.SetWarnings True
            End If
            
            Me.Requery
        End If

    End If
    '*******************************************************************************************
    
    DatenLaden

End Sub


Private Sub LSBSButtonAufBearbeitenSetzen()
    On Error Resume Next

    With Forms!F_AbholungBearbeitung!BF_LSBSErstellen
        .Caption = "LS/BS bearbeiten"
        .BackColor = RGB(205, 205, 205)
        .HoverColor = RGB(214, 214, 214)
        .PressedColor = RGB(190, 190, 190)
        .BorderColor = RGB(120, 120, 120)
        .ForeColor = RGB(0, 0, 0)
    End With

    With Forms!F_AbholterminBearbeitung!BF_LSBSErstellen
        .Caption = "LS/BS bearbeiten"
        .BackColor = RGB(205, 205, 205)
        .HoverColor = RGB(214, 214, 214)
        .PressedColor = RGB(190, 190, 190)
        .BorderColor = RGB(120, 120, 120)
        .ForeColor = RGB(0, 0, 0)
    End With

    With Forms!F_AbholpapiereBearbeitung!BF_LSBSErstellen
        .Caption = "LS/BS bearbeiten"
        .BackColor = RGB(205, 205, 205)
        .HoverColor = RGB(214, 214, 214)
        .PressedColor = RGB(190, 190, 190)
        .BorderColor = RGB(120, 120, 120)
        .ForeColor = RGB(0, 0, 0)
    End With

    On Error GoTo 0
End Sub


Private Sub Form_Close()
    Dim frm As Form
    
    For Each frm In Forms
        If HatSteuerelement(frm, "DateienImPfad") Then
            On Error Resume Next
            DirListe frm!DateienImPfad
            frm!DateienImPfad.Requery
            On Error GoTo 0
        End If
    Next frm
End Sub


Private Sub BF_Abbrechen_Click()
    DoCmd.Close
End Sub


Private Sub BF_Drucken_Click()
    Dim DateiName As String
    Dim ProjektName As String

    On Error GoTo ErrDrucken

    DatenSpeichern
    
    ProjektName = DLookup("ProjektName", "Projekte", "ProjektNr = " & ProjektNr)
    
    If LSNr > 0 Then
        DateiName = Laufwerkpfad & ProjektName & "\LS_" & LSNr & ".pdf"
        If Dir(DateiName) <> "" Then Kill DateiName
        DoCmd.OpenReport "B_LieferSchein", acViewPreview, , "ProjektNr = " & ProjektNr
        DoCmd.OutputTo acOutputReport, "B_LieferSchein", acFormatPDF, DateiName, False
        DoCmd.Close acReport, "B_LieferSchein"
        If Nz(Me!M35221, 0) > 0 Then
            EADokXmlErzeugenEinzeln "A_eADokLS35221Daten", "LSNr", LSNr, "LS_" & LSNr & "_2"
        End If
        If Nz(Me!M35231, 0) > 0 Then
            EADokXmlErzeugenEinzeln "A_eADokLS35231Daten", "LSNr", LSNr, "LS_" & LSNr & "_1"
        End If
    End If
    
    If BSNr > 0 Then
        DateiName = Laufwerkpfad & ProjektName & "\BS_" & BSNr & ".pdf"
        If Dir(DateiName) <> "" Then Kill DateiName
        DoCmd.OpenReport "B_BegleitSchein", acViewPreview, , "ProjektNr = " & ProjektNr
        DoCmd.OutputTo acOutputReport, "B_BegleitSchein", acFormatPDF, DateiName, False
        DoCmd.Close acReport, "B_BegleitSchein"
        EADokXmlErzeugenEinzeln "A_eADokBSDaten", "BSNr", BSNr, "BS_" & BSNr
    End If
    
    Exit Sub
    
ErrDrucken:
    On Error Resume Next
    DoCmd.Close acReport, "B_LieferSchein"
    DoCmd.Close acReport, "B_BegleitSchein"
    On Error GoTo 0
    FehlerMeldung "Lieferschein/Begleitschein konnte nicht vollst?ndig erstellt werden!" & vbCrLf & vbCrLf & _
                  "Bitte pr?fen Sie, ob PDF- oder XML-Dateien noch ge?ffnet sind oder der Projektordner gesperrt ist." & vbCrLf & _
                  "Technische Meldung: " & Err.Description
End Sub


Private Sub DatenLaden()
    Me!M35231 = Nz(DLookup("M35231", "Lieferscheine", "LSNr = " & LSNr), 0)
    Me!A35231 = Nz(DLookup("A35231", "Lieferscheine", "LSNr = " & LSNr), "")
    Me!M35221 = Nz(DLookup("M35221", "Lieferscheine", "LSNr = " & LSNr), 0)
    Me!A35221 = Nz(DLookup("A35221", "Lieferscheine", "LSNr = " & LSNr), "")
    Me!UebernahmeDatum = DLookup("UebernahmeDatum", "Lieferscheine", "LSNr = " & LSNr)
    Me!EmpfangsDatum = DLookup("EmpfangsDatum", "Lieferscheine", "LSNr = " & LSNr)
    Me!Transportart = Nz(DLookup("Transportart", "Lieferscheine", "LSNr = " & LSNr), "")
    Me!Transporteur = Nz(DLookup("Transporteur", "Lieferscheine", "LSNr = " & LSNr), "")
    
    If BSNr > 0 Then
        Me!M35212 = Nz(DLookup("M35212", "Begleitscheine", "BSNr = " & BSNr), 0)
        Me!A35212 = Nz(DLookup("A35212", "Begleitscheine", "BSNr = " & BSNr), "")
    Else
        Me!M35212 = Null
        Me!A35212 = Null
    End If
    BF_Drucken.SetFocus
    BF_Speichern.Visible = False
End Sub


Private Sub DatenSpeichern()
    Dim strSQL As String
    
    If LSNr > 0 Then
        strSQL = "UPDATE Lieferscheine SET " & _
                 "M35231 = " & Nz(Me!M35231, 0) & ", " & _
                 "A35231 = '" & Replace(Nz(Me!A35231, ""), "'", "''") & "', " & _
                 "M35221 = " & Nz(Me!M35221, 0) & ", " & _
                 "A35221 = '" & Replace(Nz(Me!A35221, ""), "'", "''") & "', " & _
                 "UebernahmeDatum = " & SqlDatum(Me!UebernahmeDatum) & ", " & _
                 "EmpfangsDatum = " & SqlDatum(Me!EmpfangsDatum) & ", " & _
                 "Transportart = '" & Replace(Nz(Me!Transportart, ""), "'", "''") & "', " & _
                 "Transporteur = '" & Replace(Nz(Me!Transporteur, ""), "'", "''") & "' " & _
                 "WHERE LSNr = " & LSNr & ";"
        DoCmd.SetWarnings False
        DoCmd.RunSQL strSQL
        DoCmd.SetWarnings True
    End If
    
    If BSNr > 0 Then
        strSQL = "UPDATE Begleitscheine SET " & _
                 "M35212 = " & Nz(Me!M35212, 0) & ", " & _
                 "A35212 = '" & Replace(Nz(Me!A35212, ""), "'", "''") & "', " & _
                 "UebernahmeDatum = " & SqlDatum(Me!UebernahmeDatum) & ", " & _
                 "EmpfangsDatum = " & SqlDatum(Me!EmpfangsDatum) & ", " & _
                 "Transportart = '" & Replace(Nz(Me!Transportart, ""), "'", "''") & "', " & _
                 "Transporteur = '" & Replace(Nz(Me!Transporteur, ""), "'", "''") & "' " & _
                 "WHERE BSNr = " & BSNr & ";"
        DoCmd.SetWarnings False
        DoCmd.RunSQL strSQL
        DoCmd.SetWarnings True
    End If
End Sub


Private Function SqlDatum(ByVal v As Variant) As String
    If IsNull(v) Or v = "" Then
        SqlDatum = "Null"
    Else
        SqlDatum = "#" & Format(v, "yyyy\/mm\/dd") & "#"
    End If
End Function


Private Sub BF_Speichern_Click()
    DatenSpeichern
    DatenLaden
End Sub

Private Function ErzeugeDokumentDatensatz(ByVal Tabellenname As String, ByVal Nummernfeld As String, ByVal ProjektNummer As Long, ByVal VonNr As Long, ByVal BisNr As Long) As Long
    Dim db As DAO.Database
    Dim ws As DAO.Workspace
    Dim strSQL As String
    Dim DokumentNr As Long
    Dim eADokNr As Long
    Dim Versuch As Integer
    Dim FehlerNummer As Long
    Dim FehlerText As String

    Set db = CurrentDb
    Set ws = DBEngine.Workspaces(0)

    If DCount("*", Tabellenname, "ProjektNr = " & ProjektNummer) > 0 Then
        ErzeugeDokumentDatensatz = Nz(DLookup(Nummernfeld, Tabellenname, "ProjektNr = " & ProjektNummer), 0)
        Exit Function
    End If

    For Versuch = 1 To 5
        DokumentNr = NaechsteJahresNummer(Tabellenname, Nummernfeld)
        eADokNr = NeueEADokNrMitBereich(Tabellenname, VonNr, BisNr)
        If eADokNr = 0 Then Exit Function

        On Error GoTo ErrInsert
        ws.BeginTrans
        strSQL = "INSERT INTO [" & Tabellenname & "] ([" & Nummernfeld & "], eADokNr, ProjektNr) VALUES (" & DokumentNr & ", " & eADokNr & ", " & ProjektNummer & ");"
        db.Execute strSQL, dbFailOnError
        ws.CommitTrans
        ErzeugeDokumentDatensatz = DokumentNr
        Exit Function

ErrInsert:
        FehlerNummer = Err.Number
        FehlerText = Err.Description
        On Error Resume Next
        ws.Rollback
        On Error GoTo 0

        If FehlerNummer = 3022 Then
            If DCount("*", Tabellenname, "ProjektNr = " & ProjektNummer) > 0 Then
                ErzeugeDokumentDatensatz = Nz(DLookup(Nummernfeld, Tabellenname, "ProjektNr = " & ProjektNummer), 0)
                Exit Function
            End If
        Else
            FehlerMeldung "Datensatz in " & Tabellenname & " konnte nicht erstellt werden!" & vbCrLf & vbCrLf & FehlerText
            Exit Function
        End If
    Next Versuch

    FehlerMeldung "Datensatz in " & Tabellenname & " konnte nach mehreren Versuchen nicht eindeutig angelegt werden."
End Function


Private Function NaechsteJahresNummer(ByVal Tabellenname As String, ByVal Nummernfeld As String) As Long
    Dim AktuelleNummer As Long

    AktuelleNummer = Nz(DMax(Nummernfeld, Tabellenname), 0)

    If AktuelleNummer > 0 And CLng(AktuelleNummer / 10000) = Year(Date) Then
        NaechsteJahresNummer = AktuelleNummer + 1
    Else
        NaechsteJahresNummer = Year(Date) * 10000 + 1
    End If
End Function


Public Function NeueEADokNrBS() As Long
    NeueEADokNrBS = NeueEADokNrMitBereich("Begleitscheine", 2000, 4000)
End Function


Public Function NeueEADokNrLS() As Long
    NeueEADokNrLS = NeueEADokNrMitBereich("Lieferscheine", 20000, 25000)
End Function


Public Sub EADokXmlErzeugenEinzeln(ByVal QueryName As String, ByVal FilterField As String, ByVal FilterValue As Long, ByVal FilePrefix As String)
    Dim db As DAO.Database
    Dim rs As DAO.Recordset
    Dim strSQL As String
    Dim XmlTxt As String
    Dim DateiName As String
    Dim ProjektName As String
    Dim NotifierPartyID As String
    
    Set db = CurrentDb
    
    strSQL = "SELECT * FROM [" & QueryName & "] WHERE [" & FilterField & "] = " & FilterValue & ";"
    Set rs = db.OpenRecordset(strSQL, dbOpenSnapshot)
    
    If rs.EOF Then
        FehlerMeldung "Keine Exportdaten in " & QueryName & " f?r " & FilterField & " = " & FilterValue & " gefunden!"
        Exit Sub
    End If
    
    ProjektName = Nz(DLookup("ProjektName", "Projekte", "ProjektNr = " & rs!ProjektNr), "Projekt_" & rs!ProjektNr)
    NotifierPartyID = XmlEncode(Nz(rs!NotifierPartyID, ""))
    
    XmlTxt = "<?xml version=""1.0"" encoding=""utf-8""?>" & vbCrLf
    XmlTxt = XmlTxt & "<!--created with ProTIM-->" & vbCrLf
    XmlTxt = XmlTxt & "<!-- created by: " & NotifierPartyID & " -->" & vbCrLf
    XmlTxt = XmlTxt & "<EBSConsignmentNoteNotification>" & vbCrLf
    XmlTxt = XmlTxt & "  <NotifierPartyID>" & NotifierPartyID & "</NotifierPartyID>" & vbCrLf
    XmlTxt = XmlTxt & "  <SpecifiedConsignmentNote>" & vbCrLf
    XmlTxt = XmlTxt & "    <WasteTransportMaterialMovement>" & vbCrLf
    XmlTxt = XmlTxt & "      <HandOverPartyID>" & XmlEncode(Nz(rs!TakeOverPartyID, "")) & "</HandOverPartyID>" & vbCrLf
    XmlTxt = XmlTxt & "      <TakeOverPartyID>" & XmlEncode(Nz(rs!TakeOverPartyID, "")) & "</TakeOverPartyID>" & vbCrLf
    XmlTxt = XmlTxt & "      <TypeCode>" & XmlEncode(Nz(rs!MovementTypeCode, "9008390116371")) & "</TypeCode>" & vbCrLf
    
    XmlTxt = XmlTxt & "      <LoadingLocation>" & vbCrLf
    XmlTxt = XmlTxt & "        <PostalAddress>" & vbCrLf
    
    If Nz(rs!LoadingCityName, "") <> "" Then
        XmlTxt = XmlTxt & "          <CityName>" & XmlEncode(Nz(rs!LoadingCityName, "")) & "</CityName>" & vbCrLf
    End If
    
    XmlTxt = XmlTxt & "          <PostcodeCode>" & XmlEncode(Nz(rs!LoadingPostcodeCode, "")) & "</PostcodeCode>" & vbCrLf
    
    If Nz(rs!LoadingStreetName, "") <> "" Then
        XmlTxt = XmlTxt & "          <StreetName>" & XmlEncode(Nz(rs!LoadingStreetName, "")) & "</StreetName>" & vbCrLf
    End If
    
    If Nz(rs!LoadingBuildingNumber, "") <> "" Then
        XmlTxt = XmlTxt & "          <BuildingNumber>" & XmlEncode(Nz(rs!LoadingBuildingNumber, "")) & "</BuildingNumber>" & vbCrLf
    End If
    
    XmlTxt = XmlTxt & "          <CountryID>" & XmlEncode(Nz(rs!LoadingCountryID, "AT")) & "</CountryID>" & vbCrLf
    XmlTxt = XmlTxt & "        </PostalAddress>" & vbCrLf
    XmlTxt = XmlTxt & "      </LoadingLocation>" & vbCrLf
    
    XmlTxt = XmlTxt & "      <UnloadingLocation>" & vbCrLf
    XmlTxt = XmlTxt & "        <OperatingSiteID>9008390894644</OperatingSiteID>" & vbCrLf
    XmlTxt = XmlTxt & "        <PostalAddress>" & vbCrLf
    XmlTxt = XmlTxt & "          <CityName>Soo?</CityName>" & vbCrLf
    XmlTxt = XmlTxt & "          <PostcodeCode>2504</PostcodeCode>" & vbCrLf
    XmlTxt = XmlTxt & "          <StreetName>Uhlstra?e</StreetName>" & vbCrLf
    XmlTxt = XmlTxt & "          <BuildingNumber>3</BuildingNumber>" & vbCrLf
    XmlTxt = XmlTxt & "          <CountryID>AT</CountryID>" & vbCrLf
    XmlTxt = XmlTxt & "        </PostalAddress>" & vbCrLf
    XmlTxt = XmlTxt & "      </UnloadingLocation>" & vbCrLf
    
    XmlTxt = XmlTxt & "      <MovementPeriod>" & vbCrLf
    XmlTxt = XmlTxt & "        <StartDateTime>" & XmlEncode(Nz(rs!StartDateTime, "")) & "</StartDateTime>" & vbCrLf
    XmlTxt = XmlTxt & "        <EndDateTime>" & XmlEncode(Nz(rs!EndDateTime, "")) & "</EndDateTime>" & vbCrLf
    XmlTxt = XmlTxt & "      </MovementPeriod>" & vbCrLf
    
    XmlTxt = XmlTxt & "      <SubordinateMaterialMovement>" & vbCrLf
    XmlTxt = XmlTxt & "        <TransportModeCode>" & XmlEncode(Nz(rs!TransportModeCode, "9008390100059")) & "</TransportModeCode>" & vbCrLf
    XmlTxt = XmlTxt & "        <TransportMeansID>" & XmlEncode(Nz(rs!TransportMeansID, "k.A.")) & "</TransportMeansID>" & vbCrLf
    XmlTxt = XmlTxt & "        <CarrierParty>" & vbCrLf
    XmlTxt = XmlTxt & "          <ID>" & XmlEncode(Nz(rs!CarrierPartyID, "9008390437711")) & "</ID>" & vbCrLf
    XmlTxt = XmlTxt & "        </CarrierParty>" & vbCrLf
    XmlTxt = XmlTxt & "      </SubordinateMaterialMovement>" & vbCrLf
    
    If Nz(rs!TypeCode, "") <> "" Then
        XmlTxt = XmlTxt & "      <DesignatedPhysicalProcess>" & vbCrLf
        XmlTxt = XmlTxt & "        <TypeCode>" & XmlEncode(Nz(rs!TypeCode, "")) & "</TypeCode>" & vbCrLf
        XmlTxt = XmlTxt & "      </DesignatedPhysicalProcess>" & vbCrLf
    End If
    
    XmlTxt = XmlTxt & "      <EffectiveTransfer>" & vbCrLf
    
    XmlTxt = XmlTxt & "        <HandOverParty>" & vbCrLf
    XmlTxt = XmlTxt & "          <ID>" & XmlEncode(Nz(rs!HandOverPartyID, "")) & "</ID>" & vbCrLf
    XmlTxt = XmlTxt & "        </HandOverParty>" & vbCrLf
    
    XmlTxt = XmlTxt & "        <TakeOverParty>" & vbCrLf
    XmlTxt = XmlTxt & "          <ID>9008390437711</ID>" & vbCrLf
    XmlTxt = XmlTxt & "          <SpecifiedOrganization>" & vbCrLf
    XmlTxt = XmlTxt & "            <Name>i4next international computer trading &amp; leasing Ges.m.b.H.</Name>" & vbCrLf
    XmlTxt = XmlTxt & "            <PostalAddress>" & vbCrLf
    XmlTxt = XmlTxt & "              <CityName>Soo?</CityName>" & vbCrLf
    XmlTxt = XmlTxt & "              <PostcodeCode>2504</PostcodeCode>" & vbCrLf
    XmlTxt = XmlTxt & "              <StreetName>Uhlstra?e</StreetName>" & vbCrLf
    XmlTxt = XmlTxt & "              <BuildingNumber>3</BuildingNumber>" & vbCrLf
    XmlTxt = XmlTxt & "              <CountryID>AT</CountryID>" & vbCrLf
    XmlTxt = XmlTxt & "            </PostalAddress>" & vbCrLf
    XmlTxt = XmlTxt & "          </SpecifiedOrganization>" & vbCrLf
    XmlTxt = XmlTxt & "        </TakeOverParty>" & vbCrLf
    
    XmlTxt = XmlTxt & "      </EffectiveTransfer>" & vbCrLf
    
    XmlTxt = XmlTxt & "      <PreliminaryCargoMaterial>" & vbCrLf
    XmlTxt = XmlTxt & "        <ClassificationCode>" & XmlEncode(Nz(rs!ClassificationCode, "")) & "</ClassificationCode>" & vbCrLf
    XmlTxt = XmlTxt & "        <MassQualifiedMeasurement>" & vbCrLf
    XmlTxt = XmlTxt & "          <MeasurementMeasure>" & XmlMenge(Nz(rs!MeasurementMeasure, 0)) & "</MeasurementMeasure>" & vbCrLf
    XmlTxt = XmlTxt & "          <MeasurementMethodCode>" & XmlEncode(Nz(rs!MeasurementMethodCode, "")) & "</MeasurementMethodCode>" & vbCrLf
    XmlTxt = XmlTxt & "        </MassQualifiedMeasurement>" & vbCrLf
    XmlTxt = XmlTxt & "      </PreliminaryCargoMaterial>" & vbCrLf
    
    XmlTxt = XmlTxt & "    </WasteTransportMaterialMovement>" & vbCrLf
    XmlTxt = XmlTxt & "  </SpecifiedConsignmentNote>" & vbCrLf
    XmlTxt = XmlTxt & "</EBSConsignmentNoteNotification>" & vbCrLf
    
    If Dir(Laufwerkpfad & ProjektName & "\", vbDirectory) = "" Then
        FehlerMeldung "Der Projektordner '" & Laufwerkpfad & ProjektName & "' ist nicht vorhanden. XML-Datei konnte nicht erstellt werden!"
        rs.Close
        Set rs = Nothing
        Set db = Nothing
        Exit Sub
    End If
    
    DateiName = Laufwerkpfad & ProjektName & "\" & FilePrefix & ".xml"
    WriteUtf8File DateiName, XmlTxt
    
    rs.Close
    Set rs = Nothing
    Set db = Nothing
End Sub


Private Function XmlEncode(ByVal Txt As String) As String
    Txt = Replace(Txt, "&", "&amp;")
    Txt = Replace(Txt, "<", "&lt;")
    Txt = Replace(Txt, ">", "&gt;")
    Txt = Replace(Txt, """", "&quot;")
    Txt = Replace(Txt, "'", "&apos;")
    XmlEncode = Txt
End Function


Private Function XmlMenge(ByVal Wert As Variant) As String
    XmlMenge = Replace(Trim$(Format(Wert, "0.###")), ",", ".")
    If Right$(XmlMenge, 1) = "." Then
        XmlMenge = Left$(XmlMenge, Len(XmlMenge) - 1)
    End If
End Function


Private Function FeldVorhanden(ByVal rs As DAO.Recordset, ByVal FeldName As String) As Boolean
    Dim i As Integer
    
    FeldVorhanden = False
    For i = 0 To rs.Fields.Count - 1
        If rs.Fields(i).Name = FeldName Then
            FeldVorhanden = True
            Exit Function
        End If
    Next i
End Function


Private Function NeueEADokNrMitBereich(Tabelle As String, VonNr As Long, BisNr As Long) As Long
    Dim JahrKurz As String
    Dim MaxNr As Variant
    Dim LaufendeNr As Long
    Dim VonWert As Long
    Dim BisWert As Long
    Dim Kriterium As String
    
    JahrKurz = Right(CStr(Year(Date)), 2)
    
    VonWert = CLng(CStr(VonNr) & JahrKurz)
    BisWert = CLng(CStr(BisNr) & JahrKurz)
    
    Kriterium = "eADokNr >= " & VonWert & " AND eADokNr <= " & BisWert
    
    MaxNr = DMax("eADokNr", Tabelle, Kriterium)
    
    If IsNull(MaxNr) Then
        LaufendeNr = VonNr
    Else
        LaufendeNr = CLng(Left(CStr(MaxNr), Len(CStr(MaxNr)) - 2)) + 1
    End If
    
    If LaufendeNr > BisNr Then
        FehlerMeldung "Der eADok-Nummernkreis f?r " & Tabelle & " ist ausgesch?pft."
        Exit Function
    End If
    
    NeueEADokNrMitBereich = CLng(CStr(LaufendeNr) & JahrKurz)
End Function


Private Sub WriteUtf8File(ByVal DateiName As String, ByVal Inhalt As String)
    Dim stm As Object
    
    On Error GoTo ErrWriteUtf8File
    
    Set stm = CreateObject("ADODB.Stream")
    stm.Type = 2
    stm.Charset = "utf-8"
    stm.Open
    stm.WriteText Inhalt
    stm.SaveToFile DateiName, 2
    stm.Close
    
    Set stm = Nothing
    Exit Sub
    
ErrWriteUtf8File:
    On Error Resume Next
    If Not stm Is Nothing Then
        If stm.State <> 0 Then stm.Close
    End If
    Set stm = Nothing
    On Error GoTo 0
    FehlerMeldung "Die XML-Datei konnte nicht gespeichert werden!" & vbCrLf & vbCrLf & _
                  "Bitte pr?fen Sie, ob die Datei oder der Projektordner gesperrt ist." & vbCrLf & _
                  "Technische Meldung: " & Err.Description
End Sub
